role: Main-actor @Observable chat view model shared by typed chat and voice: holds turns, streaming state, consent/queued sends, cached fact registry/tool schema, and the public chat actions (send, cancel, clear, export, regenerate, remember, refresh context). ComposerState is the narrow observable the input bar binds to.
types: ComposerState: class (@Observable @MainActor) — canSend + returnedDraft for the chat input bar
AssistantViewModel: class (@Observable @MainActor) — singleton chat conversation owner; extended by +Routing/+RoutingForwarding/+Tools/+Context files
AssistantViewModel.PendingConsentRequest: struct — a message or regeneration held for the consent sheet (provider, text, fromVoice, regenerate)
state: mem:AssistantViewModel.pendingConsentRequest.regenerate (a held regeneration rather than a new message)
file:<tmp>/EmuquChat-<epoch>.md (export; at most one kept: removeChatExports deletes older ones and runs on Clear)
mem:AssistantViewModel.actionConfirmations (AssistantActionConfirmations: destructive tool calls awaiting the user's yes in this conversation)
toplevel: AssistantViewModel.shared is created lazily on first access (static let) via init with default AppDependencies-resolved deps; no other instantiation exists in the repo. composerState = ComposerState() and sessionState = RoutingSessionState() are stored-property initializers; chatExportPrefix is a static let.
